name: Mud flat a low lake leaves
in_game: Terrain: the lidar already has the shape; this is the look (Track A's wet mud and cracked mud) plus the scatter. Shows only when the lake is down
real: A very gentle slope of silt and clay: dark and glossy at the water, paler and cracked into plates as it dries, ripple marks and shallow pans, a scatter of clam shells, a wrack line of sticks and leaves at the old high water, bird tracks.

slope.source: typical lakefront construction in North Texas; to confirm against Bean's grey-card photos

budget.note: shells and debris only; the ground is terrain

layers: edge_layer.py: wet line, stain band, scum line, algae, run-off, wrack (cards/layers.json)
references_wanted: the same stretch from a boat 15 m off, midday, grey card on the face or the ground
from 5 m, the waterline and the stain band, card in frame
a close-up (1 m) of the surface with a coin or the card for scale
the same place at a low lake (autumn) if possible: the band and what the water left
